evidence_items.claim: NatWest participated in UK FCA/Bank of England Digital Regulatory Reporting (DRR) Pilot Phase 1 and 2 (2018-2019) using ISDA CDM 2.0
evidence_items.excerpt: In 2018 and 2019, the 2 UK regulators collaborated with 7 banks to complete 2 pilots. The banks were Barclays, Credit Suisse, HSBC, Lloyds, Nationwide, NatWest and Santander.
evidence_items.caveats: Pilot from 2018-2019 (5+ years old). Historical engagement.

evidence_items.claim: NatWest Group is a co-maintainer of FINOS Fluxnova orchestration platform with James McLeod (Head of Open Source)
evidence_items.excerpt: Fluxnova is a new open source orchestration platform developed under FINOS governance and co-maintained by Fidelity, NatWest Group, Deutsche Bank, Capital One and BMO.
evidence_items.caveats: Fluxnova is NOT CDM - it's process orchestration. Shows FINOS open source capability but not CDM-specific.

null_results.implication: Not contributing to CDM despite Fluxnova participation

key_individual.name: James McLeod
key_individual.title: Head of Open Source
key_individual.role: FINOS Gold Member Representative, Fluxnova co-maintainer
